calendarFaqs.q: When did Tucson Unified start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Tucson Unified students started the 2025–26 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day for TUSD students in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day for students was Thursday, May 21, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Did TUSD release students early on Wednesdays in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The TUSD calendar states that every Wednesday students were released one hour early.

calendarFaqs.q: Were TUSD parent-teacher conference dates half days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. TUSD labels parent-teacher conference dates as half days. K–8 conference windows were September 17–19 and February 19–20, while grades 9–12 conferences were September 19 and February 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Rodeo Break for TUSD in 2026?
How many school days were in the TUSD 2025–26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists 176 school days: 88 days in the first semester and 88 days in the second semester.

customSections.label: What TUSD Families Should Know
customSections.content: Several TUSD dates affected weekly dismissal, grade-band conference schedules, and the difference between a normal school day and a no-school staff day.

groups.label: Every Wednesday was one hour early
items: The official calendar says students were released one hour early every Wednesday.
This was a weekly schedule pattern, not a small set of isolated early-release dates.

groups.label: Conference dates were half days
items: Grades K–8 had parent-teacher conference half days September 17–19 and February 19–20.
Grades 9–12 had conference half days September 19 and February 20, so older students did not follow the full K–8 conference window.

groups.label: Rodeo Break was separate from spring break
items: TUSD listed Rodeo Break on February 26–27.
Spring Break ran March 16–20, with Spring Holiday on April 3 as a separate no-school day.

groups.label: Grading and professional learning days were no-school days
items: Students did not attend on grading days October 3, December 19, and March 13.
Professional learning days on October 29 and February 4 were staff days with no school for students.
